spans.s:
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Dear, beloved.
2 Pleasing, delighting, charming.
m. (-मः)
1 A husband, a lover.
2 The deity of love,

KĀMA.
3

A sort of tree called a red variety of the Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.)
f. (-मा)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 A wife, a mistress.
E.
रम to sport, aff. अच्.

Black.
2

White.
3

Beautiful, pleasing.
m. (-मः)
1 A name common to three incarnations of VIṢṆU, or PARAŚURĀMA, the son of the Muni JAMADAGNI, born at the commencement of the second or Tretā Yug, for the purpose of punishing the tyrannical kings of the Kṣatriya race; RĀMACANDRA, the son of DAŚARATHA, king of Oude, born at the close of the second age, to destroy the demons who infested the earth, and especially RĀVAṆA the Daitya sovereign of Ceylon; and BALARĀMA, the elder and half-brother of KṚṢṆA, the son of ROHIṆĪ, born at the end of the Dvāpara or third age.
2 A name of VARUṆA, regent of the waters.
3 A horse.
4 A sort of deer.
f. (-मा)
1 A woman, a female, a pleasing or beautiful female.
2

Asafoetida.
3

A river.
n. (-मं)
1 A potherb, (Chenopodium album.)
2 A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
रम to sport, aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A lover, a gallant.
E.
रम to sport, क्वुन् aff.

n. (-ठं)
Asafoetida.
E.
रम to sport, अठन् aff.

n. (-ठं)
Asafoetida.
E.
रम to please, अठ Uṇādi aff., and the radical vowel lengthened.

m. (-निः)
Asafoetida.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Causing pleasure, pleasing, charming, delightful.
n. (-णं)
1 Sporting, playing.
2 Dalliance, amorous sport.
3 Coition, copulation.
4 The mons veneris.
5 A sort of cucumber.
m. (-णः)
1 A name of KĀMA or love.
2 A husband.
3 A lover, a gallant.
4 An ass.
f. (-णा or -णी)
1 A woman, or an agreeable woman, a wife, a mistress, &c.
2 A kind of metre, having eleven syllables in the first and third, and twelve in the second and fourth Pādas of every stanza.
E.
रम to sport, युच् or ल्युट् aff., fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Beautiful, pleasing.
E.
रम to please, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-ता)
Agreeableness, pleasantness.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, रमणीयत्वं.

n. (-ण्यं)
Sport, pleasure, wanton sport or dalliance.
E.
रम to sport, अन्य Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
Playing, sporting.
E.
रम to play, शतृ aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A lover, a gallant.
2 Paradise, heaven.
3 A crow.
4

Time.
5

Love or the deity KĀMA.
E.
रम to sport or stop, &c. Uṇādi aff. उति, but the final of the radical retained.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Sporting, playing.
E.
रम to please, शानच् aff.

m. (-तिः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
रमा LAKṢMĪ, and पति husband.

n. (-यं)
The lotus.
E.
रमा LAKṢMĪ, and प्रिय beloved.

m. (-म्भः)
1 A bambu.
2 The name of a monkey.
f. (-म्भा)
1 A plantain.
2 One of the Apsaras or courtezans of

Svarga.
3

A harlot, a whore.
4 A name of GAURĪ.
5 Lowing, as of a cow.
E.
रभि to sound, to begin, &c., aff. अच्.

m. (-म्भः)
The bambu, staff of a religious student.
E.
रम्भा a bambu, aff. अञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Begining, who or what begins.
2 Sounding.
E.
रभि to sound, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sounded.
n. (-तं)
Lowing, (of kine.)
E.
रभि to sound, &c., क्त aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Pleasing, delightful, agreeable, charming.
2 Handsome.
m. (-म्यः)
The champaca, (Michelia champaca.)
f. (-म्या)
1

Night.
2

The name of a river.
n. (-म्यं)
1 The root of a species of cucumber.
2 Semen virile.
E.
रम to sport, aff. यत्.

n. (-कं)
1 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world, lying to the north of Ilāvṛta; also called रमणक, and रमण्यक.
2 The root of the Paṭola, a sort of cucumber.
E.
रम्य agreeable, and कन् added.

f. (-ता)
1 Agreeableness, pleasantness.
2 Gracefulness, beauty.
E.
रम्य with तल् aff.; also with त्व, रम्यत्वं.

m. (-म्रः)
1 Purple, or the colour of the dawn.
2 Beauty, splendor.
E.
रम to please, aff. रन्.

f. (-री)
One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the musical modes.
E.
राम delighting, and करी who makes; also रामकली.

m. (-रः)
A fragrant sort of grass.
E.
राम pleasant, and कर्पूर (smelling like) camphor.

f. (-ली)
A Rāgiṇī.
E.
राम pleasant, कला sound or note, ङीप् aff.

m. (-रिः)
The name of a mountain, variously applied, but especially assigned to a mountain called Compteh or Citrakūṭa in Bundelkund, and to another near Nagpore, called now Rāmtek.
E.
राम the hero, and गिरि a mountain, the mountain of RĀMA; being one of his halting places in his progress from Oude to the Peninsula.

m. (-न्द्रः)
The hero RĀMACANDRA, the second incarnation of VIṢṆU under the name of RĀMA.
E.
राम, and चन्द्र the moon, the moon-like RĀMA.

f. (-नी)
The mother of BALARĀMA.
E.
राम, and जननी mother; hence it is equally applicable to REṆUKĀ, the mother of PARAŚURĀMA, and to KAUŚALYĀ, the mother of RĀMACANDRA.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Beautiful, pleasing.
E.
रमणीय the same, and वुञ् aff.

m. (-तः)
The monkey HANUMĀN, the friend and messenger of RĀMA.
f. (-तिः-ती)
A shrub, apparently a variety of basil with small leaves.
E.
राम RĀMA, and दूत a messenger.

m. (-गः)
A small species of the areca or betel-nut tree, (Areca triandra, Rox.)
E.
राम RAMA, and पूग areca.

m. (-द्रः)
The hero RĀMACANDRA.
E.
राम the same, and भद्र auspicious.

f. (-णा)
A sort of Vīṇā or lute.
E.
राम RAMA, and वीणा a lute; it may be also ironically applicable to the horn blown by BALARĀMA, and called still the Rāmsinh.

m. (-रः)
A variety of the Saccharum Sara, a sort of grass.
E.
राम RĀMA, and शर the Sara.

m. (-खः)
The monkey king SUGRĪVA.
E.
राम RĀMA, and सख friend; RĀMA having restored him to his throne, whence he had been driven by another monkey chief BALI.

n. (-णं)
1 The first epic poem of the Hindus, recording the adventures of RĀMA the son of DAŚARATHA, sovereign of Oude; written by the poet

VĀLMIKI.
2

A name of several poems on the life and adventures of RĀMA.
E.
राम the prince so named, and अयन abode.

m. (-लः)
1 KĀMA or

CUPID.
2

A lover, a husband.
E.
राम pleasing, agreeable, इलच् aff.
